questions.text: How many people normally live here, including those temporarily away during the fire?
Do two families sharing one building form one household?
Who lives alone and might need help leaving a threatened area?
questions.source_motivation: single-person household does not imply helplessness

questions.text: Which children and adults are members of the same household?
How many residents moved away rather than merely evacuated overnight?
questions.source_motivation: temporary protective movement versus usual-residence change

questions.text: Which households changed membership after a birth?
How many people died during the disaster, without assuming that every death was caused by it?
Who is related by parenthood even though they live apart?
Which organizations remain identifiable when their staff change?
questions.source_motivation: organization persistence is not personnel equality

questions.text: Did marriage or divorce change a legally recognized partnership?
Which people share essential living arrangements without being relatives?
How many evacuees are still away from their usual homes?
When did an organization begin or cease to exist?
Are visitors counted as residents in this estimate?
Which households lack a conventional dwelling but still share provision for essentials?
questions.source_motivation: household does not require dwelling ownership
